public.description: Default profile for general MCP clients. Keeps high-signal task, review, settings, dialog, and workflow tools visible.

ops.description: Operational profile for recovery, cleanup, Solo conversation management, and long-queue proof workflows.

full.description: Complete explicit tool surface, including diagnostics and compatibility shortcuts that public clients can usually reach through traecn_preflight or traecn_run_command.

tools.name: traecn_get_capabilities
tools.description: Return a compact agent-facing capability catalog for low-token discovery.

tools.name: traecn_list_commands
tools.description: List every stable TraeCNclaw command exposed to agents.

tools.name: traecn_run_command
tools.description: Execute a stable TraeCNclaw command by name. Use traecn_list_commands for parameters.

tools.name: traecn_plan_operation
tools.description: Create a compact confirmation/preflight plan before executing a side-effecting TraeCN command.

tools.name: traecn_preflight
tools.description: Return one compact status/readiness/queue/dialog summary plus optional command confirmation plan.

tools.name: traecn_run_task
tools.description: Delegate a task to TraeCN and wait for the final response when possible.

tools.name: traecn_queue_task
tools.description: Submit a task for queue-aware background processing and return a taskId.

tools.name: traecn_poll_task
tools.description: Poll a queued TraeCN task by taskId.

tools.name: traecn_wait_task
tools.description: Wait locally for a queued TraeCN task to reach a terminal or decision-required state.

tools.name: traecn_resolve_task_review
tools.description: Resolve a gateway task checkpoint in awaiting_review state. This is separate from TraeCN internal keep/revert review gates.

tools.name: traecn_adopt_current_task
tools.description: Recover tracking for the currently queued/running TraeCN request without resending the prompt.

tools.name: traecn_cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a queued or review-waiting TraeCN background task.

tools.name: traecn_stop_generation
tools.description: Stop the current TraeCN generation or queued model request.

tools.name: traecn_get_review_gate_status
tools.description: Inspect whether TraeCN is blocked on its internal keep/revert review gate.

tools.name: traecn_resolve_review_gate
tools.description: Resolve TraeCN internal keep/revert review gate.

tools.name: traecn_dismiss_dialog
tools.description: Dismiss the current TraeCN dialog.

tools.name: traecn_restart_debug_session
tools.description: Restart TraeCN with remote debugging enabled using the existing logged-in profile.

tools.name: traecn_review_code
tools.description: Ask TraeCN to review code, a diff, or a review instruction with findings-first output.

tools.name: traecn_get_status
tools.description: Check whether the TraeCN gateway is connected.

tools.name: traecn_switch_model
tools.description: Switch the active TraeCN model with fuzzy matching.

tools.name: traecn_switch_mode
tools.description: Switch TraeCN between SOLO and IDE modes.

tools.name: traecn_create_chat
tools.description: Create a new TraeCN chat.

tools.name: traecn_list_solo_chats
tools.description: List real Solo-mode TraeCN conversations from the Solo sidebar.

tools.name: traecn_switch_solo_chat
tools.description: Switch to a real Solo-mode TraeCN conversation by index or visible text.

tools.name: traecn_cleanup_queue_probe_chats
tools.description: Find and optionally delete accidental queue-probe Solo conversations without sending another prompt to TraeCN.

tools.name: traecn_get_cleanup_watch_status
tools.description: Read local cleanup watcher lock/PID/stale status without contacting TraeCN or creating conversations.

tools.name: traecn_start_long_queue_proof
tools.description: Start the guarded GLM-5.2 long-queue proof. Defaults to dry-run; execute=true plus allowQuotaSpend=true is required for a new real TraeCN submission.

tools.name: traecn_get_long_queue_proof_status
tools.description: Read the latest or marker-scoped GLM-5.2 proof status without sending any TraeCN prompt.

tools.name: traecn_cancel_long_queue_proof
tools.description: Cancel the latest or marker-scoped GLM-5.2 proof watcher/task tracking without resubmitting a prompt.

tools.name: traecn_submit_solo_task
tools.description: Submit a task into a real Solo conversation and return a taskId; background polling switches back to that conversation to collect queued results.

tools.name: traecn_get_settings
tools.description: Read TraeCN settings from the current or named section.

tools.name: traecn_set_setting
tools.description: Set a TraeCN setting by label.

tools.name: traecn_respond_dialog
tools.description: Respond to the current TraeCN dialog by approving, denying, confirming, answering, or dismissing it.

tools.name: traecn_get_dialog_status
tools.description: Check whether TraeCN is showing a dialog that needs user confirmation.

tools.name: traecn_get_queue_status
tools.description: Check current model queue/busy status.

tools.name: traecn_open_project
tools.description: Open a local project path in TraeCN.

tools.name: traecn_run_unattended_workflow
tools.description: Run a multi-step TraeCN workflow. Follow-ups auto-continue by default; set reviewRequired=true and autoContinue=false for human task checkpoints.
